definitions.units: SDK counts / SDK counts per second; not newtons
definitions.axes: SDK xyz; physical axes/surface normals unverified
definitions.derivative: signed difference of vector magnitude / actual read_end interval; masked at boundaries
definitions.windows: (t-W,t], causal held integrals and past increments; full same-segment context required
definitions.events: positive-training-q25 hysteretic activity proxy, off=on/2; retrospective peak/duration/rise
definitions.risk: exploratory uncalibrated scores; no success/failure/slip/danger labels
definitions.repeated: retained; neither invalid nor evidence of hardware acquisition
definitions.weighting: sample pooled distributions; normalization sensitivity also equal episode weight; occupancy also duration-weighted
definitions.legacy: inventory/quality only, excluded from native distributions and fitting
